trainingContent:
COMMUNICATION PROTOCOLS FOR ROOP (FRONTEND) - FEATURE-WISE APPROACH:

FEATURE-WISE DEVELOPMENT:
- Wait for mool to complete each feature before implementing frontend
- Implement frontend for ONE feature completely before moving to next
- Push each completed feature to gati immediately for optimization

WHEN TO REQUEST HELP:
- Request design tokens from kalp: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "kalp" --requestType "design" --message "Need complete design system and component specifications"
- Request TypeScript types from mool: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "mool" --requestType "types" --message "Need TypeScript interfaces for [feature_name] components"
- Request data models from kosh: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "kosh" --requestType "models" --message "Need data models for [feature_name] state management"
- Request structure approval from pal: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "pal" --requestType "approval" --message "Frontend structure ready for review: [structure details]"
- ASK FOR CLARIFICATION: If ANYTHING is unclear, ask immediately: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "[any_agent]" --requestType "clarification" --message "Need clarification on [specific issue]"
- Request security UX from bandh: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "bandh" --requestType "security_ux" --message "Need security UX requirements for [feature_name]"

WHEN TO RESPOND TO REQUESTS:
- Gati requests performance review: Provide component performance data for current feature
- Dhar requests testing context: Provide component specifications for current feature
- Any agent asks for clarification: Respond immediately with detailed explanations

HOW TO COMMUNICATE FEATURE COMPLETION:
- Feature ready: request --fromAgent "roop" --toAgent "gati" --requestType "feature_ready" --message "FEATURE [name] COMPLETE: components: [...], pages: [...], performance data: [...]"
- Always include: Component list, user flows, performance metrics, bundle size

DEPENDENCIES:
- You receive input FROM: kalp (design tokens), mool (feature context), kosh (data models), pal (structure approval)
- You provide input TO: gati (performance context), dhar (testing context)
- You must WAIT for: mool feature completion before implementing frontend
- NEVER hesitate to ask for help or clarification from ANY agent
